about: Valid ISBNs for tests and browser checks that need several books, plus invalid ones. The app no longer asks Open Library anything; the split between `found` and `notFoundInOpenLibrary` is only history (whether Open Library knew the book on 2026-10-23), and the titles are what it returned then. `invalid` fail the ISBN check. Use them in order, e.g. the first 11 `found` plus invalid[0] as the 6th search for the recent-chips test.
